hero.headline: Fan Zone
hero.subtext: Watch guides, soccer bars, and supporter groups across the West. Find where to watch, who to watch with, and how to connect with your local soccer community.

note: Information compiled October 2026. Broadcast rights, pub schedules, and supporter-group details can change; check the linked provider or venue for current details. Links open in a new tab.
tvTitle: How to watch soccer in the U.S.
tvIntro: A starting guide for the 2026-27 season, checked October 2026. These listings cover men's club competitions. Women's competitions, national-team tournaments, and domestic cups may have different broadcasters.
tvOutro: Before subscribing: check the exact fixture, live versus replay availability, commentary language, and required plan. Cable-channel access and a streaming subscription are not always interchangeable. No single subscription covers everything here. U.S. broadcast rights and channel selections can change.
tvTimingTip: Timing tip: use your local timezone in match calendars. The U.S. and Europe change their clocks on different dates, so the usual kickoff-time difference can shift temporarily.

pubsTitle: Where to watch together: soccer bars by region
pubsIntro: Top soccer bars across the West, organized by region. Confirm your match will be shown, opening time, sound availability, seating or cover charges, and any age restrictions before heading out.
pubsOutro: Know a great soccer bar we're missing? Use the contact form to suggest a venue.

pubs.name: The British Bulldog
pubs.description: A strong starting point for early European soccer and mixed-team crowds. Publishes a match schedule and advertises early openings for live games.

pubs.name: The Celtic on Market
pubs.description: A hub for multiple club supporter groups, Rapids fans, and U.S. national-team watch parties. Check its soccer page for group links and match plans.

pubs.name: The Abbey Tavern
pubs.description: Denver's official Liverpool supporters-club home. Advertises live Liverpool matches and is a natural choice for Reds fans on matchday.

pubs.name: Thin Man Tavern
pubs.description: A neighborhood bar known for showing soccer matches. Popular with local supporters for Premier League and Champions League mornings.

pubs.name: The Brit Pub
pubs.description: American Outlaws Colorado Springs' official U.S. national-team watch-party venue. A statewide destination for soccer fans outside the Denver metro.
pubs.address: 645 S Sierra Madre St Suite 100, Colorado Springs, CO 80903

pubs.name: Jack Quinn's Irish Pub
pubs.description: A popular Irish pub in downtown Colorado Springs known for showing soccer. A natural gathering spot for Premier League and international matches.
pubs.address: 21 S Tejon St, Colorado Springs, CO 80903

pubs.name: The West End Tavern
pubs.description: A rooftop bar on Pearl Street with a great atmosphere. Known for showing soccer and a popular spot for Champions League and Premier League mornings.

pubs.name: The Forge Publick House
pubs.description: A popular Old Town Fort Collins pub with a strong soccer following. Known for early Premier League openings and Champions League nights.

pubs.name: Soccer City Aurora
pubs.description: A dedicated soccer bar and community hub in Aurora. Strong ties to the local Latino soccer community and a go-to for Liga MX and international matches.

pubs.name: Steamworks Brewing Co.
pubs.description: A Durango institution and one of Colorado's best-known brewpubs. Screens for soccer and a great atmosphere for fans in the Four Corners region.

pubs.name: Alpha Charlie's Tap & Tavern
pubs.description: Veteran and locally owned gastropub in Centennial with 30 flat-screen TVs, 28 taps, and signature cocktails. A great south-metro spot for Premier League mornings and Champions League nights.

pubs.name: The Kettle Black Kitchen & Pub
pubs.description: A downtown Phoenix soccer pub with a dedicated Man City supporter following. Known for early Premier League openings and a passionate matchday crowd.

pubs.name: Crown Public House
pubs.description: Downtown Phoenix's Liverpool supporters' pub. A dedicated soccer bar with a strong Reds following and a welcoming atmosphere for all Premier League fans.

pubs.name: George and Dragon
pubs.description: A Phoenix institution and home to the local Manchester United supporters club. One of the Valley's most established soccer bars with a loyal matchday crowd.

pubs.name: Title 9 Sports Grill
pubs.description: A Phoenix sports grill and official USMNT and USWNT watch-party venue. A go-to for U.S. national team matches and a welcoming spot for all soccer fans.

pubs.name: Tombstone Brewery Company
pubs.description: A Phoenix craft brewery that screens USMNT and USWNT matches. A community gathering spot for soccer fans in the northeast Valley.

pubs.name: Yucca Tap Room
pubs.description: Tempe's Arsenal supporters' pub on the south side of Mill Avenue. A lively neighborhood bar known for early Premier League openings and a passionate Gunners crowd.

pubs.name: Pour Decisions Patio & Kitchen
pubs.description: Old Town Scottsdale's home for Newcastle United and Leeds United supporters. A lively patio bar with a strong soccer culture and dedicated matchday atmosphere.

pubs.name: O'Kelley's Sports Bar & Grill
pubs.description: A Mesa sports bar with a welcoming atmosphere and screens for soccer. A reliable East Valley destination for Premier League and Champions League watch parties.

pubs.name: Fibber Magees
pubs.description: Chandler's Tottenham Hotspur supporters' pub. An Irish-style bar with a dedicated soccer following and a welcoming crowd for Premier League mornings.

pubs.name: Beaver Street Brewery
pubs.description: A Flagstaff institution with a great taproom and screens. A solid soccer destination for fans in northern Arizona.

pubs.name: The Fox and Hounds
pubs.description: Official home of Arsenal Los Angeles and a hub for nearly every Premier League supporter group in the Valley. Opens as early as 4:30 AM for major matches with an English breakfast menu and British ales. Scarves and signed jerseys cover the walls.

pubs.name: Joxer Daly's
pubs.description: Longstanding headquarters for Liverpool and Arsenal supporters, with both clubs' official LA supporters' groups calling it home. Opens early for European matches with Irish breakfasts available. Also shows MLS and international games.

pubs.name: Tom's Watch Bar
pubs.description: Official LA Galaxy watch party venue directly across from Crypto.com Arena. Over 180 screens in a 360-degree setup so every seat has a clear view. Carries the full MLS Season Pass — one of the few bars in LA to reliably show every MLS match.
pubs.address: 1011 S Figueroa St B101, Los Angeles, CA 90015

pubs.name: Springbok Bar & Grill
pubs.description: LA's only South African-owned soccer bar and an official LA Galaxy bar partner. Shows every Galaxy match plus the Africa Cup of Nations and World Cup. Menu features South African specialties like boerewors rolls, peri-peri chicken, and biltong alongside bar classics.

pubs.name: Ye Olde King's Head
pubs.description: A second home for British expats and Premier League fans in LA's western stretches. Opens early for Premier League matches with supporter groups for Tottenham, Chelsea, and Manchester United. Features an on-site shop with imported snacks and FC merch, plus afternoon tea until 4 PM.
pubs.address: 116 Santa Monica Blvd, Santa Monica, CA 90401

pubs.name: The Greyhound Bar & Grill
pubs.description: Official home of the Los Angeles Spurs, the Tottenham Hotspur supporters' club in LA. Opens early for every Spurs match with a full English breakfast on match days. Features coordinated chants, halftime raffles, and a spacious outdoor patio.
pubs.address: 5570 N Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90042

pubs.name: La Chuperia
pubs.description: The go-to place for Liga MX and Mexican national team fans in LA. Every El Tri match shown on multiple screens with Spanish commentary. Walls adorned with soccer memorabilia and signature micheladas with tajin rims are a must-order.
pubs.address: 1145 N Mission Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90033

pubs.name: Cork & Batter
pubs.description: The closest true sports bar to SoFi Stadium, which hosted 2026 FIFA World Cup matches. A three-story venue with a modern sports lounge, rooftop bar, and restaurant. Wall-to-wall TVs and an elevated bar food menu.

pubs.name: The Pub Previews
pubs.description: San Diego's dedicated soccer pub with a strong supporter culture. Known for early openings, multiple screens, and a passionate soccer crowd in the heart of North Park.
pubs.address: 2121 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104

pubs.name: Oggi's Pizza & Brewing
pubs.description: A San Diego craft brewery chain with a strong sports-bar setup. Multiple screens and a reliable option for soccer watch parties across San Diego County.

pubs.name: The Residence
pubs.description: SF's premier soccer bar with a dedicated supporter culture. Home to multiple club supporter groups and known for early Premier League openings.

pubs.name: Blackbird Bar
pubs.description: A Castro neighborhood bar with a strong soccer following. Multiple screens and a welcoming crowd for Premier League and Champions League.

pubs.name: The Britannia Arms
pubs.description: A San Jose British pub institution with a dedicated soccer culture. Home to multiple supporter groups and a reliable destination for Earthquakes and Premier League fans.
pubs.address: 173 W Santa Clara St, San Jose, CA 95113

pubs.name: The Layover Music Bar & Lounge
pubs.description: An Oakland bar with a great atmosphere and screens for soccer. A community gathering spot for East Bay soccer fans.

pubs.name: The Shady Lady Saloon
pubs.description: A Sacramento cocktail bar with a welcoming atmosphere. Screens for soccer and a growing soccer community in the capital region.

pubs.name: The Chieftain Irish Pub
pubs.description: A SoMa Irish pub with a strong soccer culture. Known for early Premier League openings and a passionate supporter crowd.

pubs.name: The Albatross Pub
pubs.description: A beloved Berkeley pub with a community feel. Screens for soccer and a welcoming atmosphere for East Bay supporter groups.

pubs.name: Paper Plane
pubs.description: A San Jose cocktail bar with a great atmosphere. Hosts soccer watch parties and is a gathering spot for South Bay soccer fans.

pubs.name: Fieldwork Brewing Co.
pubs.description: A Sacramento craft brewery taproom with a welcoming atmosphere. Screens for soccer and a community gathering spot for Republic FC fans.

pubs.name: Vesuvio Cafe
pubs.description: A North Beach landmark with a storied history. Screens for soccer and a welcoming crowd for Champions League and international matches.

pubs.name: The Bitter End
pubs.description: Portland's dedicated soccer bar with a passionate supporter culture. Home to multiple Timbers and Thorns supporter groups and known for early Premier League openings.
pubs.address: 3929 NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland, OR 97212

pubs.name: The Cheerful Tortoise
pubs.description: A Portland sports bar with a strong soccer following. Multiple screens and a welcoming crowd for Premier League and Champions League.

pubs.name: Apex Bar
pubs.description: A beloved Portland craft beer bar with a great atmosphere. Screens for soccer and a community gathering spot for Portland soccer fans.

pubs.name: Prost!
pubs.description: A German-style beer hall in the Mississippi neighborhood. Hosts soccer watch parties and is a gathering spot for Portland's European soccer community.

pubs.name: Deschutes Brewery Portland
pubs.description: The Portland outpost of Bend's beloved Deschutes Brewery. A spacious pub with screens for soccer and a great atmosphere for matchday gatherings.

pubs.name: Ninkasi Brewing Tasting Room
pubs.description: Eugene's beloved craft brewery with a spacious tasting room. Hosts soccer watch parties and is a community hub for Lane County soccer fans.

pubs.name: The Bier Stein
pubs.description: A Eugene craft beer bar with an extensive selection and screens for soccer. A welcoming spot for Ducks fans and soccer supporters alike.

pubs.name: Deschutes Brewery Bend
pubs.description: The original Deschutes Brewery pub in downtown Bend. A Central Oregon institution with screens for soccer and a great matchday atmosphere.

pubs.name: Horse Brass Pub
pubs.description: A Portland British pub institution with a decades-long soccer tradition. One of the best places in the Pacific Northwest to watch a match.

pubs.name: Gilgamesh Brewing
pubs.description: A Salem craft brewery with a welcoming taproom. Screens for soccer and a growing soccer community in the Willamette Valley.

pubs.name: Rough and Tumble Pub
pubs.description: Seattle's only sports bar that prioritizes women's professional sports and the official home bar for FC Reign fans. Shows all Sounders games and was a top World Cup watch-party destination. Features a boozy brunch menu for early matches. A second location is in Columbia City (4914 Rainier Ave S).
pubs.address: 5309 22nd Ave NW Top Floor, Seattle, WA 98107

pubs.name: The George & Dragon Pub
pubs.description: One of Seattle's true soccer bars — not just a sports bar that shows soccer. Opens at 4 AM for Premier League and Champions League. British pub classics including fish and chips, full English breakfast, scotch eggs, and housemade sausage rolls. Two outdoor patios with big-screen TVs.

pubs.name: Atlantic Crossing
pubs.description: An official Sounders FC supporters' bar and home to the Cascadia Gooners (Seattle's Arsenal supporters club). Shows all Premier League, Champions League, MLS, and Seattle Reign matches. Generous happy hour all day Monday and 3–6 PM Tuesday through Friday.

pubs.name: Golden Roosters
pubs.description: Home to the largest screen of any soccer bar in Seattle — a 180-inch projector. Has MLS Season Pass for every MLS match. Walking distance from Lumen Field, Seattle's World Cup venue. Known for crispy fried chicken and wings in flavors like mango habanero and Korean barbecue.

pubs.name: Rhein Haus Seattle
pubs.description: Home of Sounders and Reign fans in central Seattle. Shows all regular-season MLS games, the All-Star game, cup playoffs, and league cup games. A German beer hall with bocce courts — ideal for a full day of World Cup watching between games.

pubs.name: Shawn O'Donnell's
pubs.description: A Seattle institution with multiple locations. Both the Fremont and Pioneer Square locations are official Seattle Sounders supporters' bars and open early for Premier League. The Pioneer Square location is inside a turn-of-the-century building with brick walls and dark wood booths.
pubs.address: 3601 Fremont Ave N Suite 202, Seattle, WA 98103

pubs.name: Fuel Sports Grill
pubs.description: Official home of the Emerald City Supporters, the local Sounders fan group. Packed for every Sounders match including cup and playoff games. Weekend breakfast for early East Coast games, 25 flat-screen TVs, and a giant projector. Menu covers vegetarian, vegan, and meat-heavy options.

pubs.name: St. Andrews Pub
pubs.description: Seattle's Liverpool supporters' bar — you'll never watch alone here. Shows most EPL games plus Sounders and Reign. Liverpool matches always take priority. Locals call it the best place for fish and chips in Seattle. Also hosts karaoke Thursdays and poker Mondays.

pubs.name: The Red Hot
pubs.description: A Tacoma craft beer bar with a welcoming atmosphere. Screens for soccer and a community gathering spot for South Sound soccer fans.

pubs.name: The Elk Public House
pubs.description: A Spokane neighborhood pub with a strong soccer following. Multiple screens and a welcoming crowd for Premier League and Champions League.

pubs.name: The Pub at Monte Carlo
pubs.description: A Strip-adjacent British pub with a dedicated soccer culture. Known for early Premier League openings and a passionate supporter crowd in Las Vegas.
pubs.address: 3770 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

pubs.name: The Griffin
pubs.description: A downtown Las Vegas bar with a great atmosphere and screens for soccer. A welcoming spot for Premier League and Champions League watch parties.

pubs.name: Khoury's Fine Wine & Spirits
pubs.description: A Summerlin neighborhood bar with a strong soccer following. Multiple screens and a welcoming crowd for weekend soccer mornings.
pubs.address: 8520 W Desert Inn Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89117

pubs.name: Crafthaus Brewery
pubs.description: A Henderson craft brewery with a welcoming taproom. Hosts soccer watch parties and is a community gathering spot for Las Vegas soccer fans.

pubs.name: Velveteen Rabbit

pubs.address: 1218 S Main St, Las Vegas, NV 89104

pubs.name: Brasserie Saint James
pubs.description: Reno's beloved craft brewery pub. Screens for soccer and a community gathering spot for northern Nevada soccer fans.

pubs.name: The Depot Craft Brewery Distillery
pubs.description: A Reno craft brewery in a historic train depot. Screens for soccer and a welcoming atmosphere for northern Nevada soccer fans.

pubs.name: PT's Pub
pubs.description: A Las Vegas neighborhood pub chain with a strong sports-viewing culture. Multiple screens and a reliable option for soccer watch parties across the valley.
pubs.address: 4980 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103

pubs.name: Remedy's Tavern
pubs.description: A Henderson sports bar with a welcoming atmosphere. Screens for soccer and a reliable destination for Premier League and Champions League watch parties.
pubs.address: 2265 E Warm Springs Rd, Henderson, NV 89014

pubs.name: The Jungle Bar
pubs.description: A Reno neighborhood bar near UNR with a strong soccer following. A welcoming spot for Premier League mornings and international match days.

fansOutro: Want to organize a gathering? Start with a featured match, agree on a venue and local kickoff time, confirm the venue's screening and capacity, and share the organizer's contact and attendance details. Soccer Center does not currently run these events; the linked groups and venues handle their own gatherings.
